scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @carely/api && npm run build -w @carely/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @carely/api && npm run typecheck -w @carely/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @carely/api && npm run test:i18n -w @carely/web
scripts.postinstall: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate -w @carely/api
